name: tpl-absence-2-nogoal
task: Don't drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a pure restriction. `key_lost`'s definition already embeds the condition — the event fires only when the key is dropped while `door_open` is false ('acquired and then lost before the door was opened') — so the plain hard `Absence(key_lost)` is the right clause and no `Precedence` is needed. The machine has no final state and the rule-only warning is valid, since nothing is commanded unconditionally.

texts: Never lose the matching key while the door is still closed.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, key_lost) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, key_lost, u1) -> -10
